text.zh-CN:
周围神经病变是脑和脊髓以外的神经受损，可影响感觉、肌肉或自动调节功能。

- 感觉神经受损可造成麻木、刺痛或烧灼痛。
- 运动神经受损可能使脚无力或走路不稳。
- 自主神经受损可能涉及血压、消化或排尿，不只是手脚发麻。
text.en:
Peripheral neuropathy damages nerves outside the brain and spinal cord.

- Sensory damage can cause numbness, tingling or burning pain.
- Motor damage may weaken feet or impair walking.
- Autonomic damage can affect blood pressure, digestion or urination.

text.zh-CN:
需要寻找可处理的原因。

- 糖尿病相关的长期高血糖可损伤神经。
- 神经外伤、带状疱疹、过量饮酒或部分药物也可能造成损伤。
- 维生素B12缺乏等原因需要化验判断，不能见麻木就盲目补充维生素。
text.en:
Look for a treatable cause.

- Long-term high glucose in diabetes can damage nerves.
- Injury, shingles, heavy alcohol use and some medicines may contribute.
- B12 deficiency requires assessment rather than assuming all numbness needs vitamins.

text.zh-CN:
突然或快速恶化不能等待慢病复诊。

- 新发明显无力、不能行走，或伴呼吸吞咽困难，应立即评估。
- 突然单侧无力、口角歪或说话不清，需要按可能卒中寻求急救。
- 脚部破损同时出现红肿扩散、发热或发黑，应及时就医。
text.en:
Sudden or rapidly worsening problems need urgent care.

- New major weakness, inability to walk or breathing or swallowing difficulty needs immediate assessment.
- Sudden one-sided weakness or speech trouble requires emergency stroke assessment.
- Spreading redness, fever or dark tissue around a foot wound needs prompt care.

text.zh-CN:
早期评估有助减少进一步损伤。

- 持续麻刺、感觉下降、烧灼痛或平衡变化，应预约检查。
- 脚上的伤口不愈合，即使不太痛也需要评估。
- 糖尿病等高风险人群应按安排检查神经和足部。
text.en:
Early assessment may limit further damage.

- Persistent altered sensation, burning pain or balance changes warrants review.
- A non-healing foot wound needs care even without much pain.
- People at higher risk need planned nerve and foot checks.

text.zh-CN:
检查要同时回答是否损伤以及为何损伤。

- 医生测试感觉、肌力和反射，并核对用药及饮酒情况。
- 神经传导检查测量信号速度和强度，肌电图观察肌肉电活动。
- 血糖、维生素B12等化验寻找病因；检查组合按表现选择，不一定人人做活检或扫描。
text.en:
Testing assesses nerve damage and its cause.

- Examination checks sensation, strength and reflexes alongside medicine and alcohol history.
- Nerve conduction tests measure signal speed and strength; electromyography (EMG) measures electrical activity in muscles.
- Tests such as blood glucose and vitamin B12 seek causes. The combination depends on symptoms; biopsies or scans are not needed for everyone.

text.zh-CN:
麻木无力可能来自不同位置。

- 局部神经受压可只影响一部分区域，多神经受损常从脚开始。
- 脊柱或中枢神经问题也可影响感觉和力量。
- 症状分布、起病快慢与查体有助区分，不能仅凭麻木这个词诊断。
text.en:
Numbness and weakness can originate in different locations.

- A single compressed nerve differs from a pattern affecting many nerves, often starting in feet.
- Spinal or central nervous system problems can also affect strength and sensation.
- Distribution and speed of onset guide diagnosis.

text.zh-CN:
治疗兼顾病因、疼痛与功能。

- 改善糖尿病控制或纠正已确认的营养缺乏，可帮助部分患者。
- 神经痛可能需要专门药物，普通止痛药未必有效。
- 肌力和平衡训练、支具或步行辅助能改善日常安全。
text.en:
Treatment addresses cause, pain and function.

- Glucose management or correction of confirmed deficiency can help selected causes.
- Nerve pain often needs medicines beyond ordinary painkillers.
- Strengthening, balance work and suitable aids support daily safety.

text.zh-CN:
神经痛药的名称不等于另一个诊断。

- 部分药也用于抑郁或癫痫，这里可能是利用其调节疼痛信号的作用。
- 嗜睡、头晕和视物模糊会影响驾驶和操作机器，出现时应停止这些活动并咨询。
- 剂量通常逐步调整；疗效或副作用不理想时复诊，不自行长期加量。
text.en:
A medicine's other uses do not imply another diagnosis.

- Some nerve-pain medicines also treat depression or epilepsy; here they may be used to adjust pain signals.
- Drowsiness, dizziness or blurred vision can make driving and machinery unsafe; stop these activities and seek advice if affected.
- Doses are adjusted gradually; review benefit and side effects rather than escalating yourself.

text.zh-CN:
营养建议必须与病因相符。

- 已证实B12缺乏时，按病因补充比泛泛吃保健品更重要。
- 有糖尿病者饮食需服务于血糖管理。
- 减少过量饮酒；其他补充剂的证据并不一致，先核对相互作用。
text.en:
Nutrition advice must match the cause.

- Confirmed B12 deficiency needs appropriate replacement rather than generic supplements.
- Diabetes-related care should support glucose management.
- Reduce heavy alcohol use and check uncertain supplements for interactions.

text.zh-CN:
感觉减退时要主动保护皮肤和步行安全。

- 经常查看足部破皮、红肿或水疱，不依赖疼痛提醒。
- 选择合脚鞋并注意环境中的绊倒风险。
- 对温度感觉不清时避免直接接触很热的物体，以免未察觉受伤。
text.en:
Reduced sensation requires active protection.

- Inspect feet for wounds, redness or blisters instead of relying on pain.
- Use suitable footwear and reduce trip hazards.
- Avoid direct contact with very hot objects when temperature sensation is impaired.

text.zh-CN:
基础病和治疗背景影响管理。

- 糖尿病患者需将足部检查与血糖管理结合。
- 正在接受可能伤神经的药物治疗者，应报告症状，不能自行停掉关键治疗。
- 老年人或已有步态不稳者，需同时关注药物头晕和跌倒风险。
text.en:
Background illness and treatment influence care.

- Diabetes requires combined foot and glucose management.
- Report symptoms during potentially nerve-toxic treatment without stopping essential drugs yourself.
- Older or unsteady people need attention to dizziness and falls.

text.zh-CN:
恢复取决于损伤原因和程度。

- 部分可治疗原因控制后会改善，另一些损伤可能长期存在。
- 随访应检查感觉、肌力、伤口以及疼痛对睡眠的影响。
- 范围扩大或功能下降时重新评估，而不只更换止痛药。
text.en:
Recovery depends on the cause and degree of damage.

- Some cases improve after treatment; others persist.
- Review sensation, muscle strength, wounds and how pain affects sleep.
- Spreading symptoms or declining function needs reassessment rather than only switching painkillers.

text.zh-CN:
并发症常与感觉和自动调节损害有关。

- 足部小伤未察觉可发展为溃疡或感染，严重时损害组织。
- 肌力和平衡下降会增加日常受伤风险。
- 自主神经受累可能导致血压、消化或排尿问题，需要分别处理。
text.en:
Complications reflect loss of sensation and regulation.

- Unnoticed foot injuries may become ulcers or serious infection.
- Weakness and poor balance raise injury risk.
- Autonomic symptoms affecting blood pressure, digestion or urination need specific care.

text.zh-CN:
并非所有原因都能预防。

- 控制糖尿病等可改变因素，避免长期过量饮酒。
- 使用可能影响神经的药物时，按安排监测并报告新症状。
- 通过足部保护和早期处理伤口，减少二次损伤。
text.en:
Not every cause is preventable.

- Manage modifiable factors such as diabetes and heavy alcohol use.
- Follow monitoring plans for medicines affecting nerves.
- Foot protection and early wound care help prevent secondary injury.

limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
